dedupe_resolutions.notes: Vance's end-times statement was made in a broad faith interview and did not explicitly concern Iran or any particular official act. It remains a distinct governance and risk-framing statement rather than being merged into the Iran/Hormuz war record.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The shared White House fact sheet reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One record concerns announced company agreements; the other concerns an administration-reported program measurement.

The August employment release is an independently measured economic outcome. Trump's subsequent trade threat used the report as context but is a distinct presidential risk statement with no implementing instrument; neither record substitutes for the other.

rejected_candidates.title: Trump demand to pass the SAVE America Act
rejected_candidates.reason: The post repeated a legislative demand already documented as part of the July election-files record. It identified no new administration action, enacted bill, committee vote or implementing instrument after the boundary.

rejected_candidates.title: Data-center pledge and Ukraine missile opinion links
rejected_candidates.reason: The two Truth Social links promoted outside opinion columns urging future congressional or administration action. Neither documented an enacted law, appropriation, order, contract, delivery or independently verified policy change.

rejected_candidates.title: Image-only Truth Social post
rejected_candidates.reason: The post contained no reviewable text or independently established federal action. It remains in the separate raw feed and does not support a canonical finding.

rejected_candidates.title: White House arcade website
rejected_candidates.reason: The newly publicized games promoted administration themes but did not create, implement or measurably change federal policy. The item was treated as political messaging below the national publication threshold.

rejected_candidates.title: Reported request to remove a Pennsylvania measles death from CDC tally
rejected_candidates.reason: The consequential causal claim still depended primarily on unnamed sources and lacked confirmation from a second independent outlet or a public directive. It remains a research lead rather than a canonical finding.

rejected_candidates.title: Truth Social posts without independently qualifying action
rejected_candidates.reason: Five posts appeared after the prior snapshot. One supplied the primary record for the separately corroborated trade threat; the SAVE America demand, two opinion links and image-only post remained in the raw feed because they added no qualifying federal action.

rejected_candidates.title: Ongoing disputes, prospective claims and duplicate coverage
rejected_candidates.reason: Repeated Iran, Venezuela, mail-ballot, Smithsonian, Triumphal Arch and personnel coverage added no independently verified lifecycle change after the boundary. Prospective claims without an instrument or sufficient confirmation were withheld.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive discovery leads
rejected_candidates.reason: Unit-specific external measurements remain separate discovery inputs and contribute zero canonical entries by default. No upstream item advanced without original-source inspection and full Record review.
